name: gearshift
description: Selects a development workflow that matches the complexity of each coding task.

interface.shortDescription: The right development process for the task at hand.
interface.longDescription: Gearshift routes coding work into Quick, Standard, or Full workflows so process rigor stays proportional to task complexity.
defaultPrompt: Use $gearshift:init to initialize Gearshift in this repository.
Use $gearshift:quick to make this small, clear change directly.
Use $gearshift:full to plan and implement this complex change.
